name: ファイル名と容量の詳細フッター
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One actual Lighthouse component LH15-0010: file-name and size metadata footer, no full app screen/device.
Image1 ORIGINAL is primary for alignment, spacing and fine visual details: use ONLY its centered two-line footer at source x0 y2262 w1179 h178. No icons or controls exist within this footer; do not invent any. Image2 OUR MOCK is secondary for exact Japanese localized content and locked typography. Source filename bold is overridden by established Japanese Regular body role. Image3 approved bus white-material restraint only; do not borrow its layouts/content.
Visible text VERBATIM: "礼拝準備の写真.jpg" on first line; "93 KB · 5日前に更新" on second line. Keep extension, units, spaces, middle dot, digits and Japanese exact. Meiryo Regular14/24px filename, Regular12/16px metadata, letter spacing0. Do not make the filename oversized or bold.
Compact logical width390px with16px padding, two centered lines, no unnecessary vertical space. Pure white canvas and white footer surface; barely perceptible neutral top separator if needed, no decorative card around every text line, no deep shadow. Ink#1D1D1D first line, supporting#6E6E6E second.
Accent decision: Original footer is neutral and has no selected/status/action state. Omit accent colors and gradients; no forced forest-green button, file icon or badge. Keep original fine spacing priority while preserving locked Japanese type roles.
No header/menu/share toolbar/photo/source watermark, extra labels/buttons/rows/numbers, IDs, captions or presentation text. Render the complete simple footer as a polished restrained design candidate.
reviewNotes: 原図・自作を開いて確認。中央2行のファイル詳細でアイコン・操作・意味のある強調がないため中立に維持。生成を目視：礼拝準備の写真.jpg、93 KB・5日前に更新の内容と2行構造を保持。白面と細い中立区切りのみ、余分なカードや操作なし。中点の正確な幅・Meiryoメトリクスは未証明、所有者承認・編集性・実装未確認。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
